text:
Type: flatwoven runner rug
Use: covering a narrow floor area, hallways and beside beds or counters; hallway, entryway, kitchen, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: flatwoven fibre with a fine basket-weave texture
Colors: light warm beige, taupe
Shape: long rectangle, flat and thin, solid tone with a subtle woven dot texture, clean straight edges, slim
Feel: calm, light, understated
Goes with: white walls, light wood, rattan, linen; Scandinavian, coastal or minimalist rooms

product.name: MORUM
product.description: The rug is perfect for outdoor use since it is made to withstand rain, sun, snow and dirt.
